response: Romeo and Juliet, heirs to the feuding Montague and Capulet families, fall instantly in love at a masquerade and secretly marry. After Romeo kills Juliet’s cousin Tybalt in a duel, he is banished. To escape an arranged marriage, Juliet fakes her death, but Romeo, unaware of the ruse, believes her truly dead and poisons himself beside her. Juliet awakens, finds Romeo dead, and kills herself. The double suicide finally ends the families’ bitter feud.
